name: Primitive Assembler
description: An assembly line for the DNA primitives. A conveyor carries primitives in one at a time; each lifts off the belt and snaps onto a growing vertical stack on the assembly pedestal — the '+' of assemblage made watchable. The animated, interactive form of primitive_stack.build(): the y_cursor loop externalised into space and time. Bridges the spine: primitives in, array/transform motion on the belt, colour assemblage out.
theoreticalGrounding: Assemblage is a verb, not a noun. A static stack shows the sum; the assembler shows the addition. The 'mode' parameter gives colour its three readings across the colour theme's bloom: a property (constant), a function of index (gradient), a relation to the neighbour (relational).

primitive_assembler.description: Conveyor-fed assembly station. Primitives ride in on a directional belt and snap onto a growing stack on an illuminated pedestal, a live formula placard assembling in step (● + ■ + ▲). Loops: assemble, hold (turntable), clear, repeat. Reuses the exact DNA alphabet from primitive_stack.
primitive_assembler.qfep_connection: F_order: structure as a sequence of additions, run in time — the loop made watchable.
